acts.title: Convoy Run
acts.blurb: Learn to fly, shoot and act on the edge of Sector Nebula-7.

acts.title: The Ashfall Belt
acts.blurb: The Iron Armada sends its bombers and its fastest ace.

acts.title: The Crown Rift
acts.blurb: Break the blockade and face Lord Castigan himself.

twists.how: Right after newGame() adds the squads, the enemy ship whose pilot id equals twist.pilot gets sh and shMax increased by twist.param.
In startRound(), when G.round becomes 1, every living enemy ship whose pilot id equals twist.pilot (or every enemy ship if twist.pilot is null) gets focus set to twist.param.
Right after newGame() adds the squads, the enemy ship whose pilot id equals twist.pilot gets ps increased by twist.param (capped at 12), so it moves later and fires earlier.
The campaign's isWon(G) and metrics.won return false if the player's ship whose pilot id equals twist.pilot is no longer alive, even when the player's side won the battle.
The chapter sets ex.roundCap to twist.param so missionCheck() ends the battle at that round on points destroyed, and isWon(G) counts only G.winner === 'P1' as a win (a draw is a loss).
In aiTarget(s), for enemy-side ships, a target whose pilot id equals twist.pilot gets its value multiplied by (1 + twist.param) before the best target is picked.

intro.text: Varro, the convoy leaves at dawn. Before that, I want you comfortable at the stick.
One Armada drone is loose in open space. No rocks, no tricks. Pick a maneuver and fly.
Green lines are easy, red lines strain the engines. Got it, Marshal.

outro.text: Clean flying. You kept your nose on the target. That is half of every dogfight.

opponent.name: Drill Wing Flight Officer
opponent.personality: A rookie in a target-practice fighter. Flies straight and panics when chased.

goal.text: Fly into range and destroy the lone Drill Wing fighter.

easier.text: Same drone, but the coach suggests every maneuver for you.

intro.text: Two drones this time. Get close: at range 1 you roll an extra attack die.
Stay in their blind side. A ship can only shoot what sits in its front arc.
Close in, stay out of their arc, shoot first. Understood.

outro.text: Range 1 hurts. I can feel the difference in the dice.
Good. Tomorrow we add the rocks.

opponent.name: Drill Wing Flight Officer
opponent.personality: Two drones flying in a loose pair; they rarely cover each other.

goal.text: Destroy both enemy fighters before round 12.

easier.text: Both drones are rookies with the lowest pilot skill.

intro.text: Asteroids are back. Fly through one and you roll for damage and lose your action.
After every move you get one action: focus, or a target lock to fire your torpedoes.
Lock first, then torpedoes from range 2 or 3. And keep clear of the rocks.

outro.text: Moving, shooting and acting. You are ready for the real convoy.

opponent.name: Onyx Squadron Pilot
opponent.personality: Armada patrol pair that likes to hide behind asteroids.

goal.text: Destroy both patrol fighters among the asteroids.

easier.text: The asteroids are cleared from the field.

intro.text: The convoy is jumping. "Knifepoint" and a wingman are waiting at the gate.
She is fragile, but deadly up close. Do not let her reach range 1 in your blind side.
One heavy fighter? I was hoping for a challenge, Varro.

outro.text: Gate's clear. Convoy, you are free to jump.
The Armada will notice this. Expect bombers next.

opponent.name: "Knifepoint"
opponent.personality: Fast and fragile. Dives straight for range 1 and gambles on the extra die.
opponent.taunt: Too slow, Varro. Range 1 always wins.
opponent.praise: Hah. You kept me at arm's length. Smart pilot.

goal.text: Win the core duel: destroy "Knifepoint" and her wingman.

intro.text: A Talon Maul bomber is inbound for the convoy, with one escort.
It is slow and tough. Stay out of its front arc and wear it down.
Hammer Lead to convoy: surrender your cargo or burn.

outro.text: Bomber down. The convoy slips through.

opponent.name: Hammer Squadron Lead
opponent.personality: Methodical bomber crew that trusts its armour and flies the straight line.

goal.text: Destroy the bomber and its escort.

stars.text: Destroy the bomber and its escort

easier.text: The bomber crew flies like rookies.

intro.text: Four Armada fighters wait in the station's shadow. You get a wingman this time.
Fly together so they cannot gang up on one of you.
Spend your focus on me if you can. Oh, wait. You can't.

outro.text: Their best ace is coming for you now, Varro.

opponent.name: "Hex"
opponent.personality: A jinx who leads a swarm. Attackers cannot spend focus or reroll against her.

intro.text: Sorin Vael, the Armada's top ace, flies a Razor interceptor with two wingmen.
Wren Talvo and Garrick Dray fly with you. Wren's shots strip an enemy's agility.
Stress only sharpens me. Come and tire me out, if you can.

outro.text: The Red Streak is down. The Belt is ours.
Next stop is the Crown Rift. Castigan is waiting there.

opponent.name: Sorin Vael
opponent.personality: Proud and fearless. Takes red maneuvers on purpose and turns the stress into focus.
opponent.taunt: You flew well. I flew better. Go home, Compact.
opponent.praise: Brought down by a convoy guard. Remember my name, pilot.

twist.text: Boss rule: Sorin Vael starts round 1 with a focus token.

goal.text: Destroy Sorin Vael and both of his wingmen.

stars.text: Destroy Sorin Vael and both wingmen

easier.text: Sorin flies at easy and loses his opening focus.

intro.text: A Warden gunship guards the mouth of the Rift. It shoots from front and rear.
Tamsin Coe flies with you. She keeps acting while stressed: use her for the flank.
Every ship that passes pays the toll. Yours will pay in parts.

outro.text: Gunship silenced. The Rift is open.

opponent.name: Kira Scald
opponent.personality: Patient hunter. Parks the gunship where both arcs cover the approach.

goal.text: Destroy the Warden gunship and its two escorts.

stars.text: Destroy the gunship and its escorts

easier.text: The gunship crew plans at normal instead of hard.

intro.text: I carry the Rift codes. If my courier goes down, the whole run is for nothing.
"Wailer" and his screaming wing are hunting her. Keep Quill alive.
Find the courier! Everyone near me, roll again and roll true!

outro.text: Codes delivered. The blockade's gate will open for us.
Then there is only Castigan left.

opponent.name: "Wailer"
opponent.personality: Loud wing leader who keeps his swarm tight and hunts the weakest ship.

twist.text: Mission rule: if Quill Marren's courier is destroyed, the mission fails.

goal.text: Destroy all four Armada fighters with Quill Marren still flying.

stars.text: Win with Quill Marren still flying

easier.text: The swarm plans at normal and the courier may be lost.

intro.text: Lord Castigan leads in person: two actions every turn, and now a reinforced hull.
Take down his wingmen first, or catch him at range 1. Do not chase him alone.
The Compact sends a convoy guard to my Rift. How very brave.
Wren, Tamsin, on me. This ends today.

outro.text: Retreat. All ships, retreat. This is not over, Varro.
The Rift is ours and the convoy is home. Well flown, all of you.

opponent.name: Lord Castigan
opponent.personality: Cold and exact. Never takes a risk he does not need and always finishes a crippled ship.
opponent.taunt: Kneel, Varro. The Rift belongs to the Armada.
opponent.praise: You have earned this sector, pilot. Enjoy it while it lasts.

twist.text: Boss rule: Lord Castigan's Talon Prime has 2 extra shields.

goal.text: Destroy Lord Castigan and his three escorts.

easier.text: Castigan's wing plans at normal and loses the extra shields.

unlock.text: Title: Ace of the Crown Rift
